latest_release.name: Aseprite v1.3.18.6
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

* Fixed crash introduced in v1.3.18.4 pasting tilemaps + better support to copy & paste tilemaps between different layers/sprites [#6037](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/issues/6037) [#6009](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/issues/6009)
* Sprite Sheet JSON: Escape line breaks correctly for exported user data [#6044](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/issues/6044)
* Fixed base64 encoding for certain brushes in `user.aseprite-brushes` file [#3220](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/issues/3220)
* Linux: X11 improvements for resizing and Ctrl+keyboard shortcuts [#6038](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/issues/6038)
* Lua API:
  * Fixed dialog relayout not invalidating display and contents [#5766](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/issues/5766)

## PRs
* Escape newlines as part of DocExporter (fix #6044) by @ckaiser in https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/pull/6045
* Fix build.sh path quoting when the repo path contains spaces. by @Cerallin in https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/pull/6047
* [lua] Fix dialog relayout not invalidating display and contents (fix #5766) by @ckaiser in https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/pull/6043
* Fix crash pasting tilemaps w/matching flags by @dacap in https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/pull/6053
* [win] Locate vcvars64.bat via vswhere instead of hardcoding the path by @Cerallin in https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/pull/6054

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/compare/v1.3.18.5...v1.3.18.6
